features.title: Common Grid Export (PDF + Excel)
features.summary: Reusable export dialog that allows any listing page to export DxDataGrid data as PDF or Excel with configurable options.
features.content:
The **Common Grid Export** feature provides a single `showExportDialog()` method in `SystematicCommon` that any component can call to present an export dialog.

### Capabilities
- **Export Type**: PDF or Excel
- **Paper Size** (PDF only): A4 or Dynamic Width
- **Orientation** (PDF only): Portrait or Landscape
- **Margins** (PDF only): Configurable Left, Top, Right, Bottom margins (mm)
- **Signature Block**: Optional multi-person signature section at end of report
- **Custom Footer**: Optional HTML-formatted footer text

### Source File
`SmartHR_UI/src/app/common/systematic.common.ts`

---

### Interfaces

```typescript
export interface GridExportSignature {
  label: string;    // e.g. "Prepared By"
  name?: string;    // e.g. "Min Thu Aung"
  title?: string;   // e.g. "Jr. HR Executive"
}

export interface GridExportOptions {
  gridInstance: any;                                     // DxDataGrid .instance
  reportTitle: string;                                   // e.g. "Salary Calculation (Feb 2026)"
  fileName: string;                                      // e.g. "Salary_Calculation_Feb_2026"
  excludeColumns?: string[];                             // Column names to exclude
  fixedColumnWidthMap?: { [dataField: string]: number }; // Override width for columns
  defaultColumnWidth?: number;                           // Default column width in mm (default: 18)
  marginLeft?: number;                                   // Left margin in mm (default: 15)
  marginTop?: number;                                    // Top margin in mm (default: 15)
  marginRight?: number;                                  // Right margin in mm (default: 15)
  marginBottom?: number;                                 // Bottom margin in mm (default: 10)
  signatureBlock?: GridExportSignature[];                // Signature block at end of report
  customFooterHtml?: string;                             // Custom footer with basic HTML
}
```

---

### Methods

#### `showExportDialog(options: GridExportOptions)`
Displays a SweetAlert2 dialog with export type, paper size, orientation, and margin options. On confirm, calls `generateGridPdf()` or `generateGridExcel()`.

#### `generateGridPdf(options, paperSize, orientation)`
Generates PDF using jsPDF + DevExtreme `exportDataGrid`.

**PDF Layout:**
- **Header**: Company name (bold 10pt) + Report title (bold 12pt, blue #2287EE) + horizontal line
- **Column Header**: Blue background (#2287EE) with white bold text
- **Body**: Grid data with 6pt font, cell padding
- **Signature Block**: Evenly spaced columns with label, dotted line, name, title
- **Page Footer**: "Powered by Smart HR" + print user/date + page numbers

**Paper Size Options:**
- **A4**: Fixed 210x297mm (portrait) or 297x210mm (landscape)
- **Dynamic Width**: Auto-calculated from total column widths

#### `generateGridExcel(options)`
Generates Excel using ExcelJS + DevExtreme `exportDataGrid`.

**Excel Layout:**
- **Row 1**: Company name (bold 12pt)
- **Row 2**: Report title (bold 14pt)
- **Row 3**: Separator line
- **Row 4+**: Grid data
- Signature block + footer at the end

---

### Dependencies
- `jspdf` — PDF generation
- `devextreme/pdf_exporter` — Grid-to-PDF
- `exceljs` — Excel workbook generation
- `devextreme/excel_exporter` — Grid-to-Excel
- `file-saver` — File download
- `sweetalert2` — Export options dialog
- `date-fns` — Date formatting

features.title: How to Integrate Grid Export
features.summary: Step-by-step guide to add PDF + Excel export to any listing page that uses DxDataGridComponent.
features.content:
### Step 1: Add Imports ```typescript import { GridExportOptions, SystematicCommon, } from "src/app/common/systematic.common"; import { DxDataGridComponent } from "devextreme-angular"; ``` ### Step 2: Inject SystematicCommon ```typescript constructor( private myCommon: SystematicCommon, // ... other services ) {} ``` ### Step 3: Add @ViewChild for the Grid ```typescript @ViewChild("myGrid", { static: false }) myGrid!: DxDataGridComponent; ``` HTML: ```html ``` ### Step 4: Add the Export Method **Minimal:** ```typescript exportGrid(): void { if (!this.myGrid?.instance) return; this.myCommon.showExportDialog({ gridInstance: this.myGrid.instance, reportTitle: 'My Report Title', fileName: 'My_Report', }); } ``` **With Column Widths:** ```typescript exportGrid(): void { if (!this.myGrid?.instance) return; this.myCommon.showExportDialog({ gridInstance: this.myGrid.instance, reportTitle: 'My Report Title', fileName: 'My_Report', excludeColumns: ['actionColumn'], fixedColumnWidthMap: { employeeName: 30 }, defaultColumnWidth: 18, }); } ``` **With Signature Block:** ```typescript exportGrid(): void { if (!this.myGrid?.instance) return; this.myCommon.showExportDialog({ gridInstance: this.myGrid.instance, reportTitle: 'My Report Title', fileName: 'My_Report', signatureBlock: [ { label: 'Prepared By', name: 'John Doe', title: 'HR Executive' }, { label: 'Checked By', name: 'Jane Smith', title: 'HR Manager' }, { label: 'Approved By', name: 'Mr. Director', title: 'Managing Director' }, ], }); } ``` **Full Example (all options):** ```typescript exportGrid(): void { if (!this.myGrid?.instance) return; this.myCommon.showExportDialog({ gridInstance: this.myGrid.instance, reportTitle: 'Salary Calculation (February 2026)', fileName: 'Salary_Calculation_Feb_2026', excludeColumns: ['Recalculate'], fixedColumnWidthMap: { fullName: 30 }, defaultColumnWidth: 18, signatureBlock: [ { label: 'Prepared By', name: 'Min Thu Aung', title: 'Jr. HR Executive' }, { label: 'Checked By', name: 'Aye Nwe Htun', title: 'Assistant HR Manager' }, { label: 'Acknowledged By', name: 'Lae War Phyu', title: 'Group HR Head' }, { label: 'Approved By', name: 'Mr. Cory', title: 'General Manager' }, ], customFooterHtml: 'Note: This report is system-generated and confidential.
Any discrepancy should be reported to HR within 7 working days.', }); } ``` ### Step 5: Add Export Button in HTML **Toolbar button:** ```html
``` **Dropdown item:** ```html Export ``` --- ### Integration Checklist | # | Task | Required | |---|------|----------| | 1 | Import `GridExportOptions`, `SystematicCommon`, `DxDataGridComponent` | Yes | | 2 | Inject `SystematicCommon` in constructor | Yes | | 3 | Add `@ViewChild` for `DxDataGridComponent` | Yes | | 4 | Add `#refName` to `` in HTML | Yes | | 5 | Add `exportGrid()` method with `showExportDialog()` | Yes | | 6 | Add Export button in HTML toolbar | Yes | | 7 | Add `signatureBlock` array | Optional | | 8 | Add `customFooterHtml` string | Optional | | 9 | Add `excludeColumns` for columns to hide | Optional | | 10 | Add `fixedColumnWidthMap` / `defaultColumnWidth` for PDF sizing | Optional | --- ### Options Reference | Property | Type | Default | Description | |----------|------|---------|-------------| | `gridInstance` | `any` | — | **Required.** DxDataGrid instance | | `reportTitle` | `string` | — | **Required.** Title in header | | `fileName` | `string` | — | **Required.** File name (no extension) | | `excludeColumns` | `string[]` | `[]` | Columns to hide in export | | `fixedColumnWidthMap` | `object` | `{}` | Override widths `{ dataField: mm }` | | `defaultColumnWidth` | `number` | `18` | Default column width in mm | | `marginLeft` | `number` | `15` | PDF left margin (mm) | | `marginTop` | `number` | `15` | PDF top margin (mm) | | `marginRight` | `number` | `15` | PDF right margin (mm) | | `marginBottom` | `number` | `10` | PDF bottom margin (mm) | | `signatureBlock` | `GridExportSignature[]` | — | Signature entries | | `customFooterHtml` | `string` | — | Footer with basic HTML | --- ### Integrated Pages | Page | Component | Route | |------|-----------|-------| | Salary Calculation | `SalaryCalculationComponent` | `/payroll-module/salary-calculation` | | Employee Salary Setup | `SalarySetupListComponent` | `/payroll-module/salary-setup-list` |
